## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The helper should preserve Unicode letters because they are alphanumeric under the stated slug rules. The pull-request description also needs the required verification section.

## Changes

The pull request adds a helper that lowercases page titles, replaces runs of separators with a single hyphen, and trims leading and trailing hyphens. It adds tests for lowercase conversion, repeated separators, and empty slugs.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/slug.py:7 — correctness — Preserve Unicode letters in page slugs — `slugify("Café")` returns `caf` instead of `café` because `[^a-z0-9]+` treats `é` as a separator. — Page titles that differ only by a trailing accented letter can generate the same slug.
- PR body — correctness — Add the required Testing section — The pull-request description omits `## Testing`. `AGENTS.md:4` requires “Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified.” — Reviewers cannot tell from the description how the slug behavior was verified.

## Suggestions

- app/slug.py:7 — tests — Test that slugs preserve digits — If `Release 2` regressed to `release` instead of `release-2`, every current test would still pass because none of the inputs contains a digit. — A regression could change URLs generated for numbered pages without triggering a test failure.
